name: Cognitive Maze v2.5.1 - Enlarged Tactical Mini-Map & Question NPC Visual Badges
notes: Version 2.5.1: Enlarges Tactical Radar Mini-Map display by 2.45x (280x180 px) with aspect-ratio preservation and enhanced clearance; introduces high-contrast pre-rendered solid badges showing station numbers (1-10) for all active and upcoming question NPCs, emerald checkmarks for cleared stations, and rose-red badges for mentor NPCs; completely eliminates terrain camouflage for upcoming question stations while preserving zero-allocation 60 FPS performance on AMD A4-6300 dual-core APU target hardware.
